column1: # Shared vectors for the opt-in "Gạch đỏ âm tiết sai chính tả khi gõ" decision.
# Consumers: TelexCore SpellingErrorTests.swift (Swift engine = macOS/Linux libtelexcore),
# Every expectation was checked against the validator's actual tables, not guessed.
#                      with the APP defaults (free marking, live spell-check, contextual
#                      English, prefer Vietnamese, teencode off). options: L = live
# accepted by the tables (they do not model c/k, g/gh, ng/ngh beyond the k-onset rule)
# --- underline decision on a composed word
# not a plausible prefix: no letters can fix it
# tone a stop coda cannot carry (huyền/hỏi/ngã on -c/-ch/-p/-t)
# onset k before a vowel the k-rule rejects
# still being typed (plausible prefix): not flagged yet
# --- engine: only Vietnamese the engine produced and will keep at the boundary
# left as typed (composed == raw keys): English / frozen by live spell-check
# auto-restore will put the raw keys back: never flagged
# auto-restore off: the composed word stays, so it is judged
